sections.Overview: Release Notes FEATURE – Expanded backbar and apron lighting throughout Toon modes, multiballs, jackpots, attract mode, and high score entry. FEATURE – Added lighting feedback for base game progress, including film collection, Marvin qualification, Taz shots, carrots, TNT, combos, and extra balls. FEATURE – Added 53 character cartoon clips for film collection, with separate clip rotation for each character. FEATURE – Added 20 Road Runner clips, with different clip sets rotating across balls. FEATURE – Updated the Ball Save animation. FEATURE – Added onscreen qualification progress for Taz Mania and Area 51 3/4. FEATURE – Added a Taz tornado animation when qualifying shots are collected. FEATURE – Added an animated ACME crate hit display with progressive damage and a hit counter. FEATURE – Added a captive ball animation and hit counter while qualifying Rocket Multiball. FEATURE – Added Duck Amuck high scores to the attract display. MENU – Added separate gameplay and attract mode brightness adjustments for the backbar and apron lights. MENU – Updated Individual LED Test with physical labels for the backbar and apron lights. MENU – Adjusted default ACME crate qualification to three hits per crate, without increasing the requirement after each collection. MENU – Adjusted default Rocket Multiball qualification to one captive ball hit for the first multiball and five hits for subsequent multiballs. MENU – Rebalanced default Taz Mania qualification to six qualifying shots for the first start, nine for the second, and eighteen thereafter. BUG FIX – Updated rendering compatibility to help prevent black screen flashing on certain versions of the Ouvislite computers. Sorry this one took so long to track down. BUG FIX – Prevented Factory Mayhem from becoming available while the crate switch is already active. BUG FIX – Increased the drop target reset pulse from 15 ms to 25 ms. BUG FIX – Corrected lighting calls during Duck Amuck phase transitions and Factory Mayhem meter updates. BUG FIX – Corrected fire shot lightshow cleanup when Satan’s Waitin’ ends. Release Notes FEATURE – Factory Mayhem wizard mode, qualified by completing all Lightning Bolt inserts. Alien Technology – play all Marvin modes. Anvil – play Anvil Multiball. Crates – open 5 Crates. Extendo Punch – collect Hook, Jab, Uppercut jackpots. Rockets – play Rocket Multiball. FEATURE – Earthquake Pills mode, unlocked by completing Crates (menu setting controls requirement). FEATURE – Taz Mania can qualify inside toon modes (shots per setting). FEATURE – Hold the action button to initiate a ball search. BUG FIX – Stacking issue when starting Duck Amuck and Rocket Multiball with TNT Add-A-Ball active. NOTE – Investigating brief screen flashing on some games. Release Notes FEATURE – 10% playfield multiplier per completed Factory Mayhem segment. FEATURE – Baseball Bugs mode with shots for singles, doubles, triples, outs (orange good, blue out). FEATURE – Rabbit Punch mode, unlocked by combos and jab, hook, uppercut jackpots. Starts with add-a-ball. Final blow lit at right ramp. NOTE – Only change from public beta was high score entry for Baseball for Bugs and Rabbit Punch. Release Notes FEATURE – Duck Amuck wizard mode. Start 6 episodes to light. Multi-phase rules that change mid-mode. Release Notes FEATURE – New episode: Satan’s Waitin’. FEATURE – New multiball: Rocket Skates. By default the second rocket multiball from hook locks. AUDIO – New callouts at the end of Giant Rocket. MENU – Difficulty setting for Taz Mania. Dimmer LED strip option. FIXES – Various bug fixes and polish. Release Notes MUSIC – Theme #1 at game start. Theme #2 for Encore Bonus. GAMEPLAY – On-screen assets and score stamp for playfield multiplier. Qualified multipliers persist between balls. SKILLSHOT – Small points on miss to start ball save timer. MENU – Carrot targets for Hare Restore. Post lock adjustments. Auto Warden reconnection. Diagnostic screen and toggle hotkey. FIXES – Ball ejection, VUK debounce, and other bug fixes. Release Notes FILM – Bully for Bugs, Rabbit of Seville. UI – Factory Mayhem progress screen for Alien Tech, Anvils, Crates, Extendo Punch, Rockets. LIGHTS – New topper and speaker lightshows. TOOLS – Warden auto reconnection. Third flipper button for servo test nav. FIXES – Instant Holes award, Iron Bird Seed icon, Taz grinder exit, Encore music restart. Release Notes FEATURE – Encore at Acme Vault after each episode. Super Genius award at right under-flipper shot. AREA 51 ¾ – New intro, display, spinner rotates qualified modes. SYSTEM – Flipper hold and trough eject optimized. New SFX. Speaker lights update. MENU – Launch coil hold removed on exit. Spelling fixes. Vault Access card disabled when next episode qualified. TNT value videos no longer queue. SEARCH – Rear VUK added. High score entry extra characters fixed. TAZ – Busted state handling, resumes on home switch. Scoop feeder options and tests. Shaker percentage setting. Release Notes FILM – Scaredy Cat. AUDIO – New inlane SFX. MENU – Options for qualifying Rocket Multiball. Marvin ship added to ball search. Reduced coin slot debounce. FIXES – Rapid Marvin ship load bug, Acme Items not activating for Rabbit Transit, end-of-episode drain issue, ignore crate switch during episode start. Release Notes ACME ITEMS – New collection animation, lightshow, SFX. AUDIO – New shaker effects and callouts. RULES – Cannot collect Acme Items during multiballs. Rabbit Fire reworked. Hyde And Go Tweet lights more shots at minimum value. LOGIC – Marvin inserts off when modes are locked out. Fewer repeats on callouts. Bonus multiplier capped at 10x. MENU – TNT ball save option. Changes to lock registration. Ball eject short hold to prevent jams. FIXES – Start spam during end-game search, Marvin same-ball play, Roadrunner jackpot collection, Super Jackpot callouts, bonus scoring, extra ball collection, player callouts. Release Notes SUB-WIZARD – Taz Mania. FILM – Long Haired Hare. MENU – Mode selection and qualification options. IMPROVEMENTS – Rabbit Fire ending, new lightshows, expanded vault eject power range. FIXES – TNT add-a-ball with Anvil Multiball stacking, attract-mode back VUK repeat firing. Release Notes LAUNCH – Initial public release.
